note: matrix maps B crop pixels to A crop pixels: x' = m[0]*x + m[2]*y + m[4], y' = m[1]*x + m[3]*y + m[5] (CSS matrix order). warp: a grid on A crop pixels (columns at x, rows at y); d holds dx,dy per node, row by row. At A point p, show the B point that the matrix maps to p + d(p) (d interpolated bilinearly). residual: median ink offset in working pixels (width 1000), by dense optical flow.
